description: This file defines the PurgeCandidateAPI class, a PHP API endpoint for managing candidate data purge operations in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for deleting and listing purgeable candidates related to a specific vacancy, with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateAPI
classes.description: A PHP API endpoint class for handling purge operations of candidate data related to specified vacancies, including listing and deletion functionalities, with validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PurgeService, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to purge candidate data for a specified vacancy ID, returning a result with the purged data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation, ensuring 'vacancyId' is positive and exists.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list candidates eligible for purge based on vacancy ID, including pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing candidates, validating 'vacancyId' and pagination/sorting parameters.
